name: Theodolite

frame.name: Micro-Missile Frame
frame.description: This weapon fires a high-speed micro-missile in a straight line and deals reduced self-damage. Move faster with this weapon equipped.

origins.name: Problem Solver
origins.description:
Dealing sustained damage to Champion, miniboss, or boss combatants exhausts them and grants this weapon handling and reload speed.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.

origins.name: Vanguard Determination
origins.description: After using your class ability, final blows with this weapon grant you bonus damage resistance.

origins.name: Field-Tested
origins.description:
Defeating targets or dealing damage with this weapon gradually increases range, stability, handling, and reload speed.

Swords gain increased charge rate and guard resistance.

perks.name: Eddy Current
perks.description: Temporarily increases reload speed and handling after sprinting or while amplified. This effect is improved when you are amplified.

enhanced.name: Eddy Current
enhanced.description: Temporarily increases reload speed and handling after sprinting or while amplified; increased reload speed and handling have a longer duration. This effect is significantly improved when you are amplified.

perks.name: Reconstruction
perks.description: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.

enhanced.name: Reconstruction
enhanced.description: This weapon reloads itself at an improved rate over time, up to double capacity.

perks.name: Blast Distributor
perks.description: Dealing splash damage grants a bonus to Grenade stat.

enhanced.name: Blast Distributor
enhanced.description: Dealing splash damage grants an improved bonus to Grenade stat.

perks.name: Reverberation
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon increase the size of its detonations for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Reverberation
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon increase the size of its detonations for an improved duration.

perks.name: Danger Zone
perks.description: The blast radius of this weapon increases when surrounded by combatants. While active, this weapon deals significantly less damage to the wielder.

enhanced.name: Danger Zone
enhanced.description:
The blast radius of this weapon increases when surrounded by combatants. While active, this weapon deals significantly less damage to the wielder.
Base blast radius is also improved.

perks.name: Transcendent Moment
perks.description: Final blows grant bonus stats based on the weapon's damage type alignment. Light elements grant stability and handling. Dark elements grant range and aim assist. While Transcendent, this weapon gets both bonuses.

enhanced.name: Transcendent Moment
enhanced.description: Final blows grant bonus stats based on the weapon's damage type alignment. Light elements grant improved stability and handling. Dark elements grant improved range and aim assist. While Transcendent, this weapon gets both bonuses.

perks.name: Voltshot
perks.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

enhanced.name: Voltshot
enhanced.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for an improved short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

perks.name: Reaper's Tithe
perks.description: Multiple simultaneous final blows queue up a stacking damage buff. Timer starts on next weapon fire; final blows extend this timer.

enhanced.name: Reaper's Tithe
enhanced.description: Multiple simultaneous final blows queue up a stacking damage buff. Improved timer starts on next weapon fire; final blows extend this timer.

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.description: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Binary Orbit
enhanced.description: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for an improved duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Elemental Honing
enhanced.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus for an improved duration. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Rolling Storm
perks.description:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge.

enhanced.name: Rolling Storm
enhanced.description:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge. 
Gain increased Bolt Charge stacks when you have none.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

enhanced.name: Frenzy
enhanced.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon for an improved duration until you are out of combat.

flavor: The only number that matters is the distance between you and your target.
